plan: A seamstress who slices up close and protects herself from ranged attacks in her mist.
aSurveiller: Her W (Hallowed Mist). She can only be hit from inside it: step into the mist or wait for it to fade.
contrer: Step into her mist (W) to hit her, or back off and wait.
Don't stand in the centre of her scissors (Q): it deals true damage.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: she heals by attacking.
forces: Untouchable from range inside her mist.
faiblesses: Weak at the very start of the game.
Relies on her mist to protect herself.

sorts.P: Damage based on the target's health; heals.
sorts.Q: Scissor snips; the centre deals true damage.
sorts.E: Short dash; her attacks are empowered.
sorts.R: Needles thrown up to three times that slow.

momentFort: Strong in the mid game, very dangerous in the late game.
